projects.name: buymeatokens
projects.description: buymeatokens is Buy Me a Coffee for AI tokens: an open source support page for developers. Supporters buy a developer 1M-token bundles, and the money goes straight to the developer's own Stripe, PayPal or USDC wallet with a 0% platform fee; buymeatokens never holds the funds. Developers get a public page, token goals, README badges, a supporter wall, a website button and cookieless analytics. It is built with Next.js and Postgres and licensed under AGPL-3.0.
